# Zhara AI Search & Discovery

> Zhara AI Search & Discovery adds AI-powered product search, predictive autocomplete, trending searches and products, and personalized product recommendations to Shopify storefronts — with search analytics that connect discovery to revenue.

Zhara combines a smart search bar (instant, typo-tolerant results in ~50ms) with semantic AI search as a fallback, so shoppers find products even when their words don't match the catalog. Merchants keep full control with merchandising rules and see exactly how search converts to sales.

## What Zhara does

- AI product search: intent-based, natural-language search that understands typos, spell errors, and synonyms (e.g. "chaddi" → boxers), plus queries like "something warm for winter"
- Predictive search: instant autocomplete, search suggestions, and live results as shoppers type
- Zero-character discovery: trending searches, popular products, and suggested prompts before a shopper types anything
- Product recommender: personalized and trending recommendations in the search dropdown, home page, and product pages, plus no-results recommendations
- Search merchandising: synonym groups, product boosts, pin/bury/hide products, exclusions, keyword redirects, and custom ranking rules
- Search analytics: total searches, top search terms, searched categories, no-result searches, search conversion rate, and search-attributed revenue

## Who it's for

Shopify merchants who want storefront search that converts — especially stores with large catalogs, diverse customer vocabulary, or international shoppers. No-code installation, theme-compatible, mobile responsive, live in minutes.
